get.description: Accounts of the project with their current balance, oldest first (cursor pagination, stable order). `owner_id` matches the customer (`cus_`), payee (`pay_`) or provider account (`pva_`) the account belongs to.
One account with its current posted, pending and available balance.

Recomputed from the postings of entries effective at or before `as_of` (RFC 3339 with offset). Only entries that are `posted` count: pending (two-phase) and archived entries are excluded, so holds never move this balance. Entry status history is not stored, so an entry that is posted now counts at its effective time.

post.description:
Record up to 100 events. **Per-item**: each event is accepted or rejected on its own (a
bad one writes nothing and does not stop the others), the response is always 200 and lists
every outcome in order. Retry the whole batch safely: accepted events come back as
`duplicate`.
